dish.title: Hawaiian Huli-Huli Chicken with Grilled Pineapple and Rice
dish.description: Boneless chicken thighs marinated in pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, ginger, and garlic, grilled and turned and basted with the reduced glaze until sticky and charred. Served with grilled pineapple, white rice, and scallions.

recipe_version.title: Hawaiian Huli-Huli Chicken with Grilled Pineapple and Rice
recipe_version.description: Boneless chicken thighs marinated in pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, ginger, and garlic, grilled and turned and basted with the reduced glaze until sticky and charred. Served with grilled pineapple, white rice, and scallions.

steps.title: Prep the marinade
steps.body: Whisk the pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, ginger, and garlic. Pour 3/4 cup into a small bowl and refrigerate it for the glaze. Put the chicken and the rest of the marinade in a gallon zip-top bag.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.body: Refrigerate the chicken 1 hour (up to 4 hours), turning the bag once. Meanwhile, peel, core, and slice the pineapple, rinse the rice, and slice the scallions.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 1/2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 18 minutes; rest covered 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 4 to 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the grill and reduce the glaze
steps.body: Preheat the grill on medium-high, lid closed, for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the reserved 3/4 cup marinade in a 1-quart saucepan until syrupy and reduced by about half; it is ready before the grill is hot. Clean and oil the grate.

steps.title: Grill the chicken and pineapple
steps.body: Grill the chicken, turning every 3 minutes and brushing with the glaze after the first turn, until charred at the edges and 175 F, about 14 minutes. Grill the pineapple rings beside it until marked, about 3 minutes per side. Discard the bag marinade.

steps.title: Rest
steps.body: Rest the chicken 5 minutes and brush with the last of the glaze.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cut the lime into wedges. Slice the chicken and serve over or beside the rice with grilled pineapple, scallions, and lime wedges for squeezing.

equipment: gallon zip-top bag or shallow dish

coverage_contribution: First Hawaiian dish. A sweet glazed grilled chicken distinct from the catalog's savory grilled meats. Family-friendly summer grill.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with greek-chicken-souvlaki: a sweet soy-pineapple glaze with rice, not lemon-oregano skewers with pita. Compared with gochujang-grilled-flank-steak: chicken thighs with a pineapple glaze, no gochujang. Compared with thai-moo-ping-sticky-rice in this wave: chicken and pineapple with steamed rice, not pork skewers with sticky rice.
not_duplicate_of: Not teriyaki chicken (huli-huli adds pineapple and ketchup and is grill-basted).
